ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*new\\-object.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*text\\\.encoding\\]\\:\\:ascii.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.compression\\\.deflatestream.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.streamreader.*")) AND ScriptBlockText = RGX("readtoend$"))
